description: Guarantees full session capture and backend trace propagation for every session of the bitdrift-shop-opentelemetry demo app (ai.bitdrift.oteldemo), scoped to that app ID only. Deployed ahead of live demos so every run — including the walkthrough itself — lands a full timeline for playback, instead of relying on a workflow that happened to be watching. Fires on a Welcome-screen SCREEN_VIEW rather than APP_LAUNCH -- the app calls Logger.startNewSession() to start a fresh session per shopping journey (both the 'Start New Journey' button and each automated Sim 5/10 run), and every one of those transitions returns to the Welcome screen, but none of them re-fire APP_LAUNCH (a cold-process-start event only). No sampling and no additional match conditions, so it captures 100% of sessions for this app; it is not narrowed to a single device.
